# North American Blood Dynasty 2025 Tour

The North American Blood Dynasty 2025 Tour was a concert tour headlined by Swedish melodic death metal band Arch Enemy. The tour was announced on December 18, 2024, and general ticket sales for the shows began two days later. The tour began on April 14, 2025 at The Observatory North Park in San Diego, California, and concluded on May 18, 2025 at Milwaukee Metal Fest in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.
Background
The North American Blood Dynasty 2025 Tour was headlined by Swedish melodic death metal band Arch Enemy. American deathcore band Fit for an Autopsy, Danish death metal band Baest and American metalcore band Thrown into Exile was the special guests of the tour.
The tour was announced on December 18, 2024, shortly after the end of Arch Enemy's Largo Camino Al Inframundo... tour in Mexico, and ticket sales commenced at 10am local time on December 20, 2024. This was the first tour scheduled after the release of the album Blood Dynasty, and was Arch Enemy's first North American tour in three years, since their North American Siege 2022 co-headliner with Behemoth.
Development
Alongside general ticket sales, Arch Enemy offered VIP upgrades for the tour, allowing fans access to perks such as meeting the band, receiving exclusive merchandise and being granted early entry to the venues and merchandise stands. These upgrades were not available for the band's previous North American tour (2022's North American Siege co-headliner with Behemoth).
On February 21, 2025, the band announced via social media that the show in Vancouver, British Columbia on April 20, 2025 was the first show of the tour to sell out.
